column1: # Stage S13 W1, fourth of four: the ticketboard, the egui desktop viewer of the ticket registry,
# leaves `apps/` and becomes the tool crate ticketboard_desktop in `tools/tickets/`, beside its
# headless half `ticketboard_model`; its documentation mirror moves with it under
# `documentation/tools/tickets/ticketboard_desktop`.
# The package and its binary take the name `ticketboard_desktop`, and so does the eframe app id
# (the saved preferences reset, accepted). "ticketboard" stays the product's name in prose and in
# glossary anchors, so the `text` rows rewrite the token only in the files where every whole-word
# hit names the package, the binary or the app id: the crate's manifest, its entry file (the usage
# line, the app id and the eframe application name), the no-repository screen's launch hint and
# the crate README (the package and binary in its commands and its public surface). Every other
# command line that names the package is in a file another owner edits by hand.
